desc: 石墨展台绛红瓶盖，讲皮下双通路与周期装的犬猫同驱片剂详情长图
leaf: 犬猫通用体内外同驱片剂（透明圆瓶配竖纹绛红旋盖，装圆形片剂）
name: 犬猫通用内外同驱片剂款

shots.intent: 首屏用低键石墨展台与绛红瓶盖的高对比拿下第一屏停留，一秒建立犬猫通用内外同驱片剂的品类认知。
shots.textZone: 顶部 kicker 一行与两行主标题位，其下一枚冷雾胶囊副标位，左侧三行细线勾选短语栏

shots.intent: 把三条理货理由压成一行细线圆标加一枚侧视产品带，用主图一秒法则讲清适用范围。
shots.textZone: 三枚圆标下方各一行短标签位，下部雾青色带内一行主标题位

shots.intent: 用四格日常异常现象让犬猫主人立刻对号入座，在讲机制之前先把问题放大。
shots.textZone: 顶部两行主标题位（#F3F2EE），四卡下方各一枚实色标签带文字位

shots.intent: 把顾虑从宠物身上移到全屋四处日常接触点，用同框四格让买家自己算风险面。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题位（#232B31），四格下方各一行短标签位，底部一行收束短句位

shots.intent: 用一枚抽象双层块模与两条引线把体内体外两条路径讲成看得见的结构，替口头承诺做解释。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题位与一行两行短句位，右侧两条引线各一枚小标题位（#232B31）

shots.intent: 微距把瓶盖竖纹、瓶口螺纹与片剂实貌做实，用可见做工与剂型替代口头保证。
shots.textZone: 右上两行短标签位，配 hairline 细线

shots.intent: 用两格静物步骤演出直接喂食与拌入少量食物两条接受路径，消除喂药恐惧这一临门顾虑。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题位（#F3F2EE），两卡各一枚琥珀编号方框与下方实色标签带文字位

shots.intent: 用两栏通用字段把规格一次答完，把要不要问客服的成本降到零。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题位（#232B31），六行字段标签位与六枚占位值，底部一行提示短句位

shots.intent: 用封口环、瓶盖竖纹与瓶底瓶壁三处真实近景承担信任，坚决不引入证书与检测号。
shots.textZone: 卡外顶部一行 kicker 位与主标题位（#F3F2EE），三格下方各一行短标签位（#232B31）

shots.intent: 用同框三瓶与一枚无数字刻度环把按周期备货讲成可选组合，替买家完成数量决策。
shots.textZone: 上半区主标题位（#F3F2EE）与环内一行短句位，环下方三枚组合标签位

shots.intent: 收口回到首屏同一展台，用一枚圆角按钮把安全感主张换成一次低摩擦下单动作。
shots.textZone: 右半区主标题带与一行短句位（#232B31），其下一枚圆角按钮位（#F3F2EE on #8E2A2B）

style.backgroundSystem: two linked systems held to one material language: low-key graphite studio screens (seamless graphite wall #2B3138, one darker brushed-slate plinth #1E242A edged by a single amber hairline #E3A81E, one chalk riser block #F3F2EE behind the product at a different depth) used for the opening, grouping and closing screens; flat chalk #F3F2EE or cold mist #DCE2E5 infographic screens carrying rounded chalk cards with 20px corner radius, one carmine label band #8E2A2B and hairline mist dividers #C6CFD4, used for every copy-led screen; no botanical scenery, no draped fabric, no wood grain
style.direction: low-key graphite apothecary-stage pet-care detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: single-weight hairline icons only: #F3F2EE strokes inside plain circles on graphite, #8E2A2B strokes inside plain circles on chalk, matched amber square frames #E3A81E opening numbered rows, hairline dividers #C6CFD4 and one amber tick-mark ring drawn without numerals; no filled pills, no 3D orbs, no cartoon mascots, no medical crosses, no pill-and-syringe graphics, no microbe or organ illustration, no seals, shields, ribbons or medals
style.lightingSystem: controlled low-key studio light: soft directional key from the upper left at 5000K with a narrow bounce fill from the right, deep falloff into the graphite wall, one readable hard-edged shadow travelling across the slate plinth #1E242A, glossy speculars confined to the glass shoulder and the cap knurling only; macro and build screens add one raking accent from the right at 5600K; every infographic screen runs flat even high-key light at 5600K with short soft shadows and no dramatic falloff; the how-to scene uses natural window light from the left at 5200K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent low-key graphite apothecary-stage pet-care ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page image set; fixed palette of graphite studio wall #2B3138, darker brushed-slate plinth #1E242A, chalk card field #F3F2EE, cold mist infographic field #DCE2E5 ruled in hairline mist #C6CFD4, one deep carmine cap accent #8E2A2B, one amber numbering accent #E3A81E and one ink-blue type colour #232B31; cool-neutral tone; one-family modern geometric sans-serif Chinese with a wide letter-spaced latin kicker line above a two-line headline, headlines in #F3F2EE on graphite and in #232B31 on chalk and mist; background system alternating low-key graphite studio screens built from a seamless graphite wall #2B3138 with a brushed-slate plinth #1E242A edged in one amber hairline #E3A81E, and flat chalk #F3F2EE or cold mist #DCE2E5 infographic screens carrying rounded chalk cards with 20px corner radius and one carmine label band #8E2A2B; controlled low-key studio light with a soft directional key from the upper left at 5000K and bounce fill from the right, deep falloff, one readable hard-edged shadow on the slate plinth, speculars confined to the glass shoulder and cap knurling, flat even high-key light at 5600K on every infographic screen, natural window light at 5200K in the household scene; layout system of rounded 20px cards, amber square numbered frames, plain hairline icon circles, hairline dividers in #C6CFD4 and one amber tick-mark ring drawn without numerals; icon system of single-weight hairline outlines only, no filled chips, no 3D illustration, no medical cross, no seals or shields; the upright clear jar with its deep carmine ribbed screw cap held at a stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale with cap knurling, thread neck and fill line true to the reference, its contents shown as plain unprinted round tablet discs never counted into a numeric dose; any animal appears cropped above the shoulders or turned away so no individual reads as identifiable; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no botanical scenery or marble or wood, no QR codes or membership stickers, no approval or serial numbers, no certificate graphics, no fabricated certifications or protection-duration figures, no numeric tablet counts or units, no realistic germ or organ illustration.
noDrift: no botanical scenery, palm leaves, marble veining, draped fabric or wood-plank floors
no QR codes, membership stickers, store corners or contact-like numbers
no approval numbers, registration codes, serial or lot numbers, no certificate or authorisation document graphics
no fabricated certifications, lab data, test standards, efficacy rates or protection-duration figures
no numeric tablet counts, weights, ages or unit symbols in rendered copy
no realistic germ, parasite or organ illustration
style.presentationRules: the upright clear jar with its deep carmine ribbed screw cap keeps the same slight 3/4 hero angle, scale and centring across the set; cap knurling, thread neck, jar shoulder, wall thickness and fill line stay true to the reference and never gain or lose a part; contents read as plain unprinted round tablet discs with no embossed characters and are never counted into a numeric dose; the tablet body colour stays in the #E3A81E band and never shifts pale or pink; any animal appears cropped above the shoulders or turned away so no individual reads as identifiable; the product is always grounded by a contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: brushed-slate plinth #1E242A with one hairline amber edge #E3A81E, chalk matte board #F3F2EE, cold mist panel #DCE2E5 ruled with hairline dividers #C6CFD4, one shallow carmine riser block #8E2A2B used at most once per screen; a matte light-stone counter #E7E4DE stands in for the single household scene
style.typography: one-family modern geometric sans-serif Chinese; wide letter-spaced latin kicker line above a two-line Chinese headline; headline 28-42pt, sub-line 16-20pt, label 14-16pt; type in #F3F2EE on graphite fields and in #232B31 on chalk and mist fields, one carmine #8E2A2B caption allowed on chalk only; every rendered line is a placeholder wrapped in 「」, never a real slogan
